summary: `AiChatProvider` takes `composer`: `toolbar.start`/`end` order builtin ids (`attach`, `mic`, `actions`, `extra`, `send`, `trigger:<char>`) and your own `items`; `components.ComposerToolbar` lays out the row itself. Without them the composer renders as before.
howTo: If you place the composer's extra buttons through `renderActions` or `components.InputExtra` only to get them into a certain order, list them in `composer={{ toolbar: { start: ['attach'], end: ['mic', 'actions', 'extra', 'send'] } }}` (the default) and move ids around instead. A button that writes `@` into the editor becomes `'trigger:@'`, labeled from the trigger's `label` in `triggers`. Own buttons go into `items` and receive the composer controls in `onSelect(controls)`; `render(controls)` replaces the button. An item key equal to a builtin id replaces the builtin; unknown ids warn once in the console and are skipped. Memoize the `composer` object. `renderActions`, `renderSubmit` and `InputExtra` keep working unchanged.
